scope: XSAI-emu integer GEMM micro-case; do not generalize thresholds or speedups

measurement.timing_scope: four repetitions including equal C reset before each kernel; excludes input initialization, final checksum and printf
measurement.profiler: mcycle/minstret, XSAI RTL counters, ChiselDB lifetime
measurement.rtl_counter_scope: calibrated guest-instruction window: -W 3308 through the end minstret read; correctness checked in separate full runs
measurement.repetitions: two full runs per variant; exact agreement in cycles and instructions
measurement.lifetime_filter: AtCommit > 0; issue latency also requires AtIssueQue > 0 and AtCommit >= AtIssueQue

alternative_explanations: load/store dependency or replay mechanism not identifiable without load lifetime rows

action.concrete_change: loop interchange j-k-i to i-k-j so j is the contiguous inner dimension
action.precondition: row-major A, B and C; identical arithmetic result
action.risk: benefit depends on layout, shape, cache organization and compiler lowering

outcome.interpretation: nearly equal instruction count plus large strict-window replay, memory-not-ready and data-array-access reductions support the mapping
unresolved: PC-level latency values were collected on the preceding source revision; the current strict-window result does not rely on them

alternative_explanations: additional independent accumulators may also change instruction-level parallelism

action.concrete_change: compute a 2x2 output tile with four register accumulators and reuse two A/two B values
action.precondition: dimensions are divisible by two in this prototype
action.risk: larger tiles can increase register pressure, spills and code size

outcome.interpretation: committed inner loads halve and both instructions and strict-window data-array accesses fall; evidence supports data reuse
unresolved: reg4x4 exposes stack traffic but still improves total cycles; the actual regression point remains unknown

static_evidence.observation: hot-loop disassembly contains stack loads/stores, consistent with compiler spilling or stack-resident accumulators

boundary_observations.interpretation: larger tile improves ILP and total cycles here, but increases instructions and memory-system work relative to reg2x2; it is a resource-pressure warning, not yet a performance regression
